page.overview:
What is Ink Sac?

An ink sac is an item dropped by a squid upon death used to create black dye, dark prismarine, and books and quills.

A squid drops one to three ink sacs upon death. The maximum amount is increased by 1 per level of Looting, for a maximum of 1 to 6 with Looting III.

Ink sacs can be obtained as a "junk" item from fishing. The Luck of the Sea enchantment decreases the chance.

Wandering traders sometimes sell 3 ink sacs for an emerald . Apprentice level librarians also buy 5 ink sacs for one emerald.
